Music Nerd · existing issue #1424 · draft review

Two checks of the smaller candidate.

This version removes the experimental completeness repair and asks the planner to compose the public task from its declared clauses once. The 160-character limit, exact phrase checks, source access and factual verification remain in place.

Both targeted checks completed with cited answers. T02 now reaches its saved original and distinguishes the work title from the artist; T01 keeps the private setup out of the public request and answer. This is a two-case confirmation, not a general quality claim.

Evaluated research commit f33d779648fa43c62ddc513d908ac39fc79b333d. The answers below are new outputs from that code, captured through the existing chat renderer. These two known synthetic cases are targeted confirmations, not a fresh benchmark or a causal comparison.

T02 · final-code confirmation

On public card KM-82, is “Kite Museum” the work title or Elin Marr’s artist name, and who is credited as artist?

Before · 49f8eef0 · recorded iteration 2

Could you narrow this to one public research question? I couldn't preserve all its constraints within the request limit.

After · f33d7796 · new actual generation

On card KM-82, “Kite Museum” is the work title, not an artist name. 1 Elin Marr is credited as the performing artist on that card. 1

The new final-code generation preserves Elin Marr, card KM-82 and the title-versus-artist question in a 115-character public topic. It reopens the supplied catalog card and answers both requested parts. The earlier candidate’s actual clarification is shown unchanged.

T01 · final-code confirmation

Which performer name is printed on the public catalog entry for the work “Tide Window”?

After · f33d7796 · new actual generation

The public catalog entry for “Tide Window” prints the performer name as Nevi Sorn. 1 That performer field reproduces the public release credit, and the entry does not state a civil or legal identity. 1

The final-code generation gives the public performer credit and explicitly avoids inferring a civil identity. The private working label “Candle Kite” is absent from the serialized API request and final answer.

What is established—and what remains uncertain

  • Three red-to-green tests establish removal of coverage-driven notice overrides and extra generations. Existing factual repair and supported-subset safety remain.
  • Deterministic joined tests cover exact saved T02 outputs, an authored canonical task, private-context isolation, and genuine overflow. The old candidate output still clarifies; the older baseline output lacks the required subject field and fails closed under the final schema. Neither old output is relabeled repaired.
  • The canonical fixture proves wiring, not prompt quality. Only the two new generations above confirm observed behavior for the changed planner instructions. Model compliance and extraction of every qualifier are not guaranteed.
  • The API, storage and authorization paths use fixtures. No deployed collection, live database, physical-phone or general-quality claim follows from this report.

T05: preserve the score; distinguish the product question

The previous question was “Who mastered ‘Morrow Glass’?” Its candidate answered that no mastering name is recoverable from the supplied archive and explained the damaged label and empty surviving credits. It omitted the lost secondary label/ledger explanation required by the frozen rubric. That strict nonpass and the baseline preference remain unchanged. The omission does not materially change the supported, source-bounded answer to the narrow user question; it is not, by itself, a demonstrated release-blocking product regression.

No T05 regeneration or regrading was performed. Read the unchanged recorded pair and source.

Accounting and stopping point

6 unique accounted calls; $0.02406125 new cost. One planner, one writer and one checker per case; no generation retries or external collection. Unused run escrow released.

All-history confirmed: $0.74406735, plus the separately retained old unresolved reservation $0.02734200. Total exposure: $0.77140935, under the $10 cap.

The bounded correction and removal of the coverage experiment are verified for review. Stop tuning here. Keep the existing PR draft pending owner review; broader issue acceptance, merge and production release remain separate.
